verdict.rationale: The only adjacent evidence is a Carta integration that creates a cap table one click after incorporation, and a payroll registration for hiring remote employees. Neither shows Firstbase itself generating or executing offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, or option grants, so equity paperwork depends on a third-party tool and hiring paperwork is unevidenced. Missing for 10: offer-letter generation, confidentiality/IP (CIIA) agreement workflows, option-grant issuance and approval through the platform, e-signature or document management for these documents, and any independent corroboration.
